thread:
Sam (Marketing): Quick sync: final social & seeding plan for Beta launch. Need LI longform + X thread + creator micro-seeds + routing + engagement triage.
Lena (Growth): I can own seeding & tracking sheet. Target channels: X, LinkedIn, HN-like threads, and 8 creators. Will map UTMs -> SDR queues.
Priya (Content): I'll draft the LI longform (700-900 words) tying benchmark narrative into use cases. Need exact stat + short customer line.
Owen (Design): Assets: hero 1200x900 for LI, 3-slide 1080x1080 carousel for X, and a square thumbnail for creator shares. ETA 30h. Any brand constraints?
Sam (Marketing): Use launch palette, but push for higher contrast for hero. Messaging anchors: "predictable inference economics", "latency under SLOs", and bench stat: "~60% median latency improvement, ~2.8x throughput". No dollar claims.
Lena (Growth): Routing plan: utm_campaign=beta_launch -> queue=beta-sdr, utm_source=creator -> queue=creator-inbound + tag=creator. Triage rules: any inbound with words demo/pricing/POC -> high-intent.
Tori (Ops): I’ll add routing rule and capture promo code into crm.promo_code. EchoBot: Routing rule queued and validation scheduled.
Priya (Content): Draft LI opener sample: "Today we’re launching Redwood Beta — predictable inference economics for teams that ship. Benchmarks show ~60% median latency improvement across production mixes; customers report faster feedback loops and simpler cost modeling.
Founder quote: "Serving should be predictable, not a gamble."
CTA: Join beta -> https://redwood.ai/beta?utm_campaign=beta_launch"
Owen (Design): Sample X thread draft (short):
```
Tweet 1: Beta launches Wed — serve LLM features faster + cheaper. TL;DR: ~60% latency improvement. 
Tweet 2: Benchmarks: median lat down ~60% at 512 tokens; throughput ~2.8x for production mix. How? smart batching + KV cache. 
Tweet 3: Try Beta (UTM=beta_launch) or book a 15-min demo. Split CTA A/B. Pinned FAQ + webinar link. 
```
Sam (Marketing): A/B plan on final tweet: CTA_A=Join Beta (60%), CTA_B=Book Demo (40%). Lena, can you add utm_content split and drop into the tracker?
Lena (Growth): Will do. UTM scheme: utm_source={platform}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=beta_launch, utm_content={cta}_{asset}_{variant}. I'll add to tracker and share link.
Tori (Ops): Webinar capture: utm_campaign=beta_webinar -> webinar-leads queue. Automation: webinar attendee -> add tag webinar:beta and schedule 24h replay drip.
EchoBot: Reminder: post-check scheduled 2028-09-14T10:00:00Z.
Sam (Marketing): Who's monitoring day-of engagement? Need two people for triage (X replies + DMs) and an SDR to pick up high-intent leads.
Lena (Growth): I'll monitor X during launch window. Priya will monitor LI replies. Tori will ensure leads surface in CRM.
Priya (Content): Short DM follow-up for high-intent: "Thanks for checking Redwood Beta — want a quick 15-min demo? Pick a slot: https://cal.com/redwood/beta"
Owen (Design): Uploaded assets: hero_v3.png, carousel_v3.zip, thumb_square.png. Small ask: add annotated alt text and confirm chart labels show % deltas (not absolute $).
Sam (Marketing): Paid boost trigger: Claire (Paid) set rule: if organic CTR > 2% at +3h, boost top post $1k/day for 3 days. If engagement > 5% at +6h, expand audience.
Lena (Growth): Seeding notes: DM templates for creators, unique promo codes (CREATOR_01..08) that map to promo field. We'll surface creator-tracked leads separate from organic.
Tori (Ops): Implemented promo capture: promo -> crm.promo_code. Also adding a webhook to flag leads with promo and >company_size:50 as sales-ready.
Sam (Marketing): Final checklist: assets (Owen), LI draft (Priya), seeding list & outreach (Lena), UTM tracker (Lena), routing rules (Tori), monitoring roster (Sam/Lena/Priya). Reconvene Tue 9am PT for final signoff.
Priya (Content): I'll push LI draft by EOD tomorrow.
Lena (Growth): Seed list ready by tomorrow noon. I'll drop the tracker in #marketing-assets.
Sam (Marketing): Thanks team — let's keep replies tight and surface any high-intent DMs immediately. :rocket:
